title: Plan Your Visit
description: Everything you need to know before visiting Debre Mihret St. Gabriel EOTC in Christchurch
heading: Plan Your Visit
intro: We are delighted you are considering visiting our church. Here is everything you need to know to feel welcome and prepared.

parking.title: Parking
parking.body: Free parking is available on site and along the surrounding streets. Please arrive a few minutes early on feast days as spaces fill quickly. Accessible parking is available near the main entrance.

dressCode.title: Dress Code
dressCode.body: We encourage modest and respectful attire. Women traditionally cover their heads with a netela (shawl) during services, and men remove hats upon entering the church. Comfortable, conservative clothing is appropriate for all visitors.

children.title: Children
children.body: Children are welcome at all services. Sunday school classes are available for children during the main service. A quiet area is available for parents with infants. We encourage families to worship together.

whatToExpect.title: What to Expect
whatToExpect.body: Services are conducted in Ge'ez (the liturgical language) and Amharic, with portions explained in English. A typical Sunday service lasts approximately two to three hours. You will experience chanting, prayer, Scripture readings, and a sermon. Holy Communion is offered to baptised Orthodox faithful. All visitors are welcome to receive blessed bread (tsebel) at the end of the service.
